input: Phaladesh interpretation of prohibitions (meat, liquor, lying)
outcome: When the text says a native must avoid meat, liquor, lying, bad conduct, it means that native will be prone to that fault; statements like 'family will be in mourning' mean maternal uncles ruined and descent shrinking; 'your age will be longest in the house' means all other creatures in the house die before you
source: Lal Kitab 1952 Grammar portion (archive.org lal-kitab-1952-grammer-portion-page-1-to-234) phaladesh intro

input: General principle of house reading: ground lord plus building (pakka ghar)
outcome: Each house has a ground-level lord (sign-owner planet) and a building-level lord (pakka ghar planet); their friendship or enmity colours the house; a visiting planet adds its own friend/enemy relation to both; if the two are friends the house is further improved, if enemies the house's effect is ruined
source: Lal Kitab 1952 Grammar portion (archive.org lal-kitab-1952-grammer-portion-page-1-to-234) phaladesh basis

input: House 11 with Saturn ground, Jupiter pakka, Rahu arrives

remedy: Keep gold on the body (Rahu in house 11)
source: Lal Kitab 1952 Grammar portion (archive.org lal-kitab-1952-grammer-portion-page-1-to-234) phaladesh basis example
